main_text.l: Quæ cùm ita se habeant, iterū sine cunctatione concludimus, non modò anathema[?] supradicti Papæ Sixti v, propter temerarij iudicis incompetentiā, falsæ caussæ allegationem, defectum ordinis iudicialis, & conceptæ sententiæ stultitiam pro nullo habendum esse: verūmetiam, vt execrationes eiusdem Sixti in ipsius caput redundent, cum ipsum septem atrocissimis criminibus certissimisque testimoniis cōuictum, cunctis Christianis esse, dein-eps[?] oportere EXECRABILE ET DETESTAN-DVM ANATHEMA MARANATA.

page.notes: The first line of the text is set with a large initial Q, joined to "uæ". The word "anathema" is followed by a short mark before "supradicti", which I read as a spacing or hyphen mark and have marked [?]. The line break in "dein-eps" is unclear at the start of the second line, so the word is marked [?]; the first letters may be "ce", which the scan does not clearly show. The "p" of "pro" may carry a stroke (ꝓ), which the scan does not settle. The ornament below AMEN is a decorative woodcut, not text, and is not transcribed.
